question: What is the probability that a positive integer selected at random from the set of positive integers not exceeding 100 is divisible by either 2 or 5?
explanation: P(E1 U E2) = P(E1) + P(E2) - P(E1 n E2). E1 = 50 numbers (divisible by 2), E2 = 20 numbers (divisible by 5), E1 n E2 = 10 numbers (divisible by 10). P = (50 + 20 - 10) / 100 = 60 / 100 = 3/5.

options.D: The cost of searching an AVL tree is O(n log n) but that of a binary search tree is O(n)

explanation: AVL trees are self-balancing binary search trees ensuring guaranteed O(log n) search time, whereas an unbalanced Binary Search Tree (BST) can degrade to O(n) in the worst case.
